sloka: लन्काम् च आलोकयिष्यामो निलयम् तस्य रक्षसह् ।येन मे मरण अन्ताय हृता भार्या दुरात्मना ।। ६-३८-४।।
transliteration: lankām ca ālokayiṣyāmo nilayam tasya rakṣasah ।yena me maraṇa antāya hṛtā bhāryā durātmanā ।। 6-38-4।।

translations.english: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."
translations.hindi: उस पर चढकर,हम लोग उस दुष्ट रावण कों आवास-स्थली लङ्का को भी देखेंगे, जो आपनी जान खोने के लिए मेरी खी को हर लाया है
